messages.subject: Errors when trying to install Shiny in RStudio Windows

I think you have an incompatible version of R.  You will need 3.2.2 instead of 3.2.1.  Try installing R tools 3.2.2 from here:  
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/index.html.  Update the path variable when it asks you. 

Good luck!
